entry.title: Open-KNEAD: Knowledge-grounded Nutrition Estimation via Agentic Decomposition
entry.summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly used for dietary assessment from meal images, where retrieval-augmented grounding was shown to sharpen nutrition estimates. entry.title: CoRe: A Comprehensive Framework for Cross-Image Comparative Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
entry.summary: Cross-image comparative reasoning remains challenging for vision-language models (VLMs), especially when correct prediction requires fine-grained attribute grounding and globally consistent reasoning. entry.title: Evidence-Backed Video Question Answering
